description:
Relevant Experience (Yrs): 7-9 years 
 Technical/Functional Skills : 
 The client needs an experienced Lead Web Developer with knowledge in Angular/JQuery frameworks and hands on experience on the below: 
 · Java, Angular JS, JQuery JS, XML, XST, XPATH, HTML5, CSS3, AJAX 
 · Develops and designs interface, front pages, and the tools to navigate a web site. 
 · RESTful/SOAP Webservices development and interaction 
 · SOAP UI testing 
 · Good communication and presentation skills.
 Roles & Responsibilities: 
 The other responsibilities expected are: 
 · Liaise with the business and system analysts and understand the requirement and develop the necessary code 
 · Analyze Requirements and develop design & code as per the client defined standards 
 · Follow the architecture and design standards defined by the client 
 · Based on the work involved provide an estimate (as per client defined process) for the work completion and ensure on-time delivery 
 · POC (Proof-of-concept) development 
 · Perform unit testing of the code and ensure the code delivered is error free 
 · Who can roll the sleeves and make hands dirty - Hand on experience is must
 Generic Managerial/SoftSkills: 
 Good communication (Speaking and listening skills)

 Bachelor's Degree.
